summary.text: Ron Robinson is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives representing District 58 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ron Robinson's general-election opponent is Katrina Manetta (D).
He served in the U.S. Marine Corps, owns two small businesses, and previously served on the Utica City Council.

paragraphs.text: Ron Robinson served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 1989 to 1993, graduated from Utica High School in 1987, and graduated from the Specs Howard School of Media Arts in 2000.
His career experience includes owning two small businesses, and he previously served on the Utica City Council.

Robinson assumed office in the Michigan House on January 1, 2025, and in 2025-2026 is assigned to the House Appropriations Committee and the Select Committee on Protecting Michigan Employees and Small Businesses.
